summary: Iteration 2 E2E testing of MidGate — Dynamic QR, Traffic Protection, Analytics filters. Backend: 12/12 new-feature pytest passed (100%) after fixing one test to use a browser UA (python-requests UA triggers default risk block=score 80). Frontend: registration, QR page (create with live SVG preview, dynamic destination edit reflected in card), Protection page (simulator with is_bot=true -> decision='challenge', risk=55; rule create), Overview date-range Select + Compare toggle all working. Overall app is in good shape and matches the review spec.

minor.issue: Default risk thresholds combined with UA heuristic can auto-block plain scripted requests (python-requests, curl w/o UA) at score 80. This is intentional for MidGate Protect, but callers of /api/r/{alias} in tests must set a browser UA to receive a 302.

issues: Delta component renders 'no change' text without data-testid='stat-delta' when diff==0. Cosmetic only, but tests that assert on stat-delta will miss the zero-diff case. Consider adding the testid on the 'no change' span too.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='stat-delta' also to the 'no change' <span> in Overview.jsx Delta component so QA can assert on delta presence regardless of diff value.
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout fix from iteration 1 (X-Forwarded-For) is in place — confirmed by prior test; not re-run this iteration.

security.py: THRESHOLDS at (30,'allow') means score in [0,29] -> allow, [30,59] -> challenge, [60,79] -> block, [80+] -> block. UI label ranges (0–29 Allow / 30–59 Challenge / 60–79 Block / 80–100 Block) are consistent.
qr.py inserts into the same `links` collection with is_qr=True and links.py filters `is_qr:{$ne:true}` — confirmed working (QR does not appear in /api/links).
analytics.py export.csv correctly resolves workspace from the link (not header) so window.open works, and asserts membership via assert_member — verified non-member gets 404.
Redirect challenge token is HMAC-derived from (alias, visitor_id) with JWT_SECRET — good; verified challenge flow returns interstitial then 302 with mg_ch token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (QR create/edit-dynamic, Protection simulator+rule create, Overview date range + compare toggle)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@midgate.io / Admin123!. Frontend registered fresh TEST_/e2e_ users per run.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_/e2e_ prefixed users, workspaces, links, QRs, and security_rules created in midgate_db.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (12 tests, all passing). When calling /api/r/{alias} from tests always send a real browser User-Agent header, otherwise the default risk score reaches 80 and the redirect returns 403. Bot-block rules cache for 15s (security._RULES_TTL) — sleep 16s after creating a rule if you want it enforced immediately by the redirect. Frontend E2E confirmed live QR SVG preview, dynamic destination edit, protection simulator (bot=true -> challenge, risk=55), rule creation, and Overview date range + compare toggle. Note: 'stat-delta' element is only rendered when previous!=null AND diff!=0.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bugs this iteration.
